module: Base class of all flowgraph nodes. It creates the pins from the derived node's C.pinSchema, manages the behaviors (once, duration, simple...) according to C.category, runs work()/workOnce() under xpcall (errors become node errors displayed in red), draws the node in the editor (header, pins, tooltip, context menu) and serializes/deserializes the node (position, custom color, hardcoded pins, hidden pins). A modder who writes a custom node inherits from this class and overrides work, init, postInit, drawMiddle, etc.
notes: Format of C.pinSchema (read by _preInit for outputs then _postInit for inputs): {dir='in'|'out', type, name, default, description, fixed, hidden, impulse, chainFlow, tableType, hardcoded, defaultHardCodeType}. The old format without a dir field is rejected (error log). default values on an output are ignored with a warning.

self.pinIn[name] and self.pinOut[name]: access to pins by name. pinIn returns an empty pin (emptyPin, not modifiable) if the name does not exist and refuses writes. pinInLocal contains the real input pins; pinIn contains "hardcoded" inputs when a constant value is set.

Behaviors (self.behaviour): 'once', 'duration', 'simple', 'singleActive', 'obsolete'. The flow/reset/incomplete/complete/completed pins are created automatically according to the category (ui_flowgraph_editor.isFunctionalNode, isSimpleNode, isDurationNode, isF_DurationNode, isOnceNode, isDynamicNode).
Fixed order of some pins: flow in, flow out, reset in, incomplete out, complete out, completed out.
dynamicMode: 'repeat' (default, work called every time) or 'once' (workOnce once then work, with a reset pin).
Editor grid: gridSize 14, offset (10, 8); alignToGrid aligns the position to it.
Bug: isFlowActive loops over _flowInDeps but always returns true (the final return true is reached even if no dependency has flow).
Bug: in __onDeserialized, the test type(data) == 'cdata' uses the variable data (global, nil) instead of v; the cdata branch is therefore never taken.
Bug: alignToGrid references an undefined variable force (nil global); the condition depends only on nodePosition.
Bug: in _workDynamicOnce, workCount is incremented up to twice per call (once in the block, once at the end).

Functions prefixed with _ or __ are internal wrappers called by the manager/graph; the unprefixed versions (onLink, onUnlink, onSetHardcode, onUnsetHardcode, onNodeReset, onDurationXxx) are the hooks to override.

createBase.desc: Creates a node object with C as metatable and calls init(...).

use.desc: Creates a base node, copies the derived class on top, then calls _preInit (output pins), init (if redefined) and _postInit (input pins, categories, postInit).

derivedClass.desc: class of the concrete node type

C.desc: Flowgraph node. Main fields: mgr, graph, id, name, description, color, iconColor, type ('node' by default, 'simple', 'variable'), tags, behaviour, triggerCount, workCount, data, dynamicMode, durationState, pinIn, pinInLocal, pinOut, pinList (display order), nodePosition ({x, y}), customName/customColor/customIcon/customIconColor, _error.

init.desc: Initializes all node fields (identifier, name 'unknown', default color, pin tables, alignment pin). Checks for duplicate identifiers if mgr.__safeIds.

getData.desc: Returns the self.data table (the node's editable properties).

destroy.desc: Empty hook called when the node is destroyed; override to free resources.

addedToGraph.desc: Empty hook called when the node is added to a graph.

representsGraph.desc: Returns nil by default; nodes that represent a subgraph return that graph.

_preInit.desc: Creates the output pins described in pinSchema (hidden, impulse, chainFlow, tableType).

_postInit.desc: Creates the input pins from pinSchema (with hardcoded values if requested), creates a reset pin if the mode is 'once', calls handleNodeCategories then postInit.

postInit.desc: Empty hook called at the end of _postInit, once all pins are created.

handleNodeCategories.desc: According to self.category, adds the behaviors and automatically creates the flow, reset, incomplete, complete, completed pins. Logs an error if a 'simple' node has flow pins or if a 'provider' has inputs. Without a category, forces the 'repeat' mode.

removeBehaviour.desc: Disables a behavior (sets the value to false).

autoCreatePin.desc: Like createPin, but only if no pin with the same name/direction exists, then moves the pin to the position imposed by pinOrder for functional nodes.

returns.desc: the created pin, or nil if it already existed

hasFlowPins.desc: Returns whether pinSchema contains a 'flow' pin.

hasInputPins.desc: Returns whether pinSchema contains an input pin.

createResetPin.desc: Creates a 'reset' flow input pin (impulse) and adds the 'once' behavior, if it does not exist.

removeResetPin.desc: Removes the 'reset' pin and the 'once' behavior.

work.desc: Main function of the node, to be overridden. Called by the manager each time the flow passes, in an xpcall. In 'once' mode, it is called after workOnce.

workOnce.desc: Empty hook called only once (dynamic 'once' mode) when the flow arrives, before the work calls. Re-armed by a reset.

_workDynamicRepeat.desc: Runs work under xpcall, applies checkAutomatedFlow, increments workCount and records any error (node error + manager event).

_workDynamicOnce.desc: 'once' mode: handles the reset (pinIn.reset), calls workOnce once then work on each call while the flow is active.

onNodeReset.desc: Empty hook called when the node is reset (reset pin in 'once' mode).

_onNodeReset.desc: Calls onNodeReset under xpcall then sets all pinOut values back to nil.

setDurationState.desc: Changes the state of an f_duration category node and signals the change; checkAutomatedFlow then updates the incomplete/complete/completed pins and calls onDurationXxx.

checkAutomatedFlow.desc: Copies pinIn.flow to pinOut.flow for non-simple functional nodes and drives incomplete/complete/completed for f_duration nodes. 'completed' falls back to false after one frame.

onDurationInactive.desc: Empty hook: the duration state becomes 'inactive'.

onDurationStarted.desc: Empty hook: the duration state becomes 'started'.

onDurationFinished.desc: Empty hook: the duration state becomes 'finished'.

toggleDynamicMode.desc: Toggles between 'repeat' and 'once' if the category is dynamic.

setDynamicMode.desc: Sets the dynamic mode; creates the reset pin for 'once', removes it for 'repeat'.

createPin.desc: Creates a pin on the node (flowgraph/pin module), adds it to pinInLocal/pinOut, to pinList and to graph.pins. Refuses empty or duplicate names (except autoNumber, which adds a suffix 2..101).

type.desc: pin type or list of types

autoNumber.desc: number automatically in case of duplicate

removePin.desc: Removes a pin: first removes the graph links that use it, then removes the pin from the tables and from pinList. The code comment notes that other side effects remain to be checked.

renamePin.desc: Renames an input pin in pinInLocal. Refuses (with a warning) if the new name is already taken by another pin. Handles input pins only.

shiftPin.desc: Swaps a pin in pinList with its neighbor (circular) to change the display order.

idInList.desc: index (1-based) of the pin in pinList

trigger.desc: Triggers the node via self._trigger (function compiled by the manager) if the graph is not stopped; increments triggerCount and updates _frameLastUsed.

isFlowActive.desc: Supposed to tell whether a flow dependency is active, but always returns true (see notes).

showProperties.desc: Empty hook called when the node is selected to display its properties.

hideProperties.desc: Empty hook called when the selection leaves the node.

_doubleClicked.desc: Calls self:doubleClicked() if that function exists on the derived node.

onLink.desc: Empty hook called when a link is created on a pin of the node.

onUnlink.desc: Empty hook called when a link is deleted.

onSetHardcode.desc: Empty hook called when a constant (hardcoded) value is set on an input pin.

onUnsetHardcode.desc: Empty hook called when a pin's constant value is removed.

_onClear.desc: Empty (the call to _executionStopped is commented out there).

_executionStopped.desc: Empty internal hook called when execution stops.

__executionStopped.desc: Called by the manager on stop: calls _executionStopped and sets _dynamicDone back to false.

_executionStarted.desc: Empty internal hook called at start.

__executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager at start: clears the node error, sets outputs back to nil if clearOutPinsOnStart, resets _frameLastUsed and _dynamicDone, then calls _executionStarted.

getLinks.desc: Walks the graph's links and returns those arriving at the node, then those leaving it.

returns.desc: links whose target is the node
links whose source is the node

HSVtoRGB.desc: Converts HSV to RGB via the global function HSVtoRGB after reducing h to its fractional part and clamping s and v to [0, 1].

drawHeader.desc: Draws the node header (icon, name, [ERROR] if error, id if preference set, heatmap color according to the age of _frameLastUsed).

drawTooltip.desc: Draws the tooltip of the hovered node: activity in heatmap mode, name, custom name, behaviors, obsolescence, description, TODO, errors.

overDraw.desc: Draws a large semi-transparent icon over the node (call commented out in draw, so unused).

_drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central area according to the display mode (flowLevel, simple, debug, default, heatmap, geometry); calls drawMiddle if the derived node defines it.

drawMiddle.desc: Drawing hook for the middle of the node, to be overridden; the base version simply calls builder:Middle().

draw.desc: Draws the whole node in the editor: styles according to error/recent activity, header, input pins, middle (under xpcall), output pins, behavior icons. Ignores types other than node, simple, variable.

getPinInConstValue.desc: Returns the constant value of an input pin if it was set as hardcoded, otherwise nil.

customContextMenu.desc: Empty hook to add entries to the node's context menu.

showContextMenu.desc: Shows the context menu (copy, delete, show/hide pins, create a subgraph, ungroup, comment, development tools depending on preferences).

menuPos.desc: menu position (not used in the body)

_setHardcodedDummyInputPin.desc: Sets (val not nil) or removes (val nil) a constant value on an input pin: creates a dummy entry in pinIn with hardCodeType, sets pin.pinMode to 'hardcoded' or 'normal' and calls the hooks.

forceType.desc: forced type; otherwise the pin's type (or defaultHardCodeType if multiple or 'any')

returns.desc: type retained when a value is set

_setupTimeline.desc: Creates self.timeline {beginTime, endTime, lane = 0} and defines empty (nop) onTimelineBegin/End/Trigger if absent.

_onSerialize.desc: Empty hook allowing the derived node to add fields to the serialized table.

__onSerialize.desc: Serializes the node: data (without cdata), type, position, custom name/color/icon, identifier, dynamic mode, pins (if savePins), hardcoded pins, quickAccess, hidden pins, timeline.

returns.desc: node data for the graph file

__onDeserialized.desc: Restores position, customizations, data (known properties only), dynamic mode, saved pins, hardcoded values, quickAccess and hidden pins. Logs warnings if a pin cannot be found.

updateNodePosition.desc: Reads the node's position in the ImGui editor and stores it in nodePosition (if within ±2e8).

updateEditorPosition.desc: Applies nodePosition to the node in the editor (SetNodePosition). Call it only when the manager is open in the editor.

__setNodeError.desc: Records an error for a category (log E); called without a category, clears all errors.

category.desc: category ('work', 'onNodeReset'...) or nil to clear everything

__getNodeError.desc: Returns the error message of a category.

_postDeserialize.desc: Empty hook called after the full deserialization of the graph.

toString.desc: Returns a string "name (nodeType / id) in graph" for logs.

alignToGrid.desc: Aligns the node to the 14 px grid (offset 10, 8), optionally after setting a position, then updates the editor.
